gloss: to fling off; to cast aside (pride, appearances)

definitions.gloss: to fling off; to cast aside
definitions.explanation: Literally to tear off and throw away clothing roughly; now used mostly of abandoning pride, shame, appearances or restraint all at once in order to do what must be done.

examples.japanese: ⟦{恥|はじ}→恥：12636_haji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かなぐり{捨|す}てた。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦プライド→プライド：22290_puraido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かなぐり{捨|す}てて⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げた→下げる：00807_sageru⟧。
examples.english: He threw away his pride and bowed his head.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{救|すく}う→救う：02063_sukuu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体面|たいめん}→体面：18817_taimen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かなぐり{捨|す}てて⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ライバル→ライバル：11197_raibaru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{助|たす}け→助け：07777_tasuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めた→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: To save the company, the president abandoned all concern for appearances and asked his old rival for help.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive: the thing cast aside takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{恥|はじ}→恥：12636_haji⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{外聞|がいぶん}→外聞：22457_gaibun⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧かなぐり{捨|す}てる: to throw away all shame and concern for what others think
- ⟦プライド→プライド：22290_puraido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かなぐり{捨|す}てる: to throw away one's pride
- ⟦{体面|たいめん}→体面：18817_taimen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かなぐり{捨|す}てる: to abandon appearances
- ⟦{上着|うわぎ}→上着：01066_uwagi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かなぐり{捨|す}てる: to fling off one's jacket (literal)

USAGE:
The word suggests a sudden, determined act; the result is usually something the person would normally be too proud to do. かなぐり is not used on its own in modern Japanese.
